# Problem and question — expert artifact labels as ground truth under class-correlated artifacts

Cleaning studies score their methods against expert artifact labels and report gains on shared data (X0003, P_draft_Gain_On_BNCI).
## 2. Condition

## 4. Three-step sentence
I am studying expert artifact labels because I want to find out whether they depend on the class, in order to help readers understand what cleaning benchmarks measure.
## 5. Research question
How far do expert artifact labels differ between classes when artifacts are class-correlated?
